dct_description_sm: This dataset contains UAV RGB imagery and georeferenced common reed point annotations in Parc national des Îles-de-Boucherville, Quebec, Canada. It also includes an area of interest layer for each zone mapped, and a grid layer used to export data for the classification model.

dct_title_s: Data for Early Detection of an Invasive Alien Plant (Phragmites australis) Using Unoccupied Aerial Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence
